DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その写真の門をお探しですか。こちらは見学棟の入口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the gate in that photo? This is the entrance to the visitor building.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人からこの写真が届きました。「正門で待つ」とありますが、この入口とは違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の写真を示して正門と現在の入口が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend sent this photo. It says they're waiting at the main gate. Is that different from this entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your friend's photo and ask whether the main gate is the same as your current entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真には青い案内板が写っていますね。この図では青い案内板は中庭側の門にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a blue information board in the photo. On this diagram, the blue board is at the courtyard-side gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は白い受付看板の前です。友人には青い案内板から動かず待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白い看板前にいると伝え友人には青い案内板で待つよう連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm in front of a white reception sign. I'll tell my friend to stay at the blue board and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you're at the white sign and tell your friend to wait at the blue board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付から中庭への通路は、この建物の右側です。今からお一人で向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The passage from reception to the courtyard is on the right of this building. Are you going there alone now?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きな荷物があるので、階段を使わずに行けるか先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きな荷物のため階段を避けた通路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have large luggage, so I'd like to check first whether I can get there without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Because of large luggage, check a passage avoiding stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段の横に緩やかな通路がありますが、今日は荷物の搬入中です。終わるまでこちらでお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a gently sloping passage beside the stairs, but deliveries are being brought in today. You can wait here until they're finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら急いで横を通らず待ちます。搬入が終わったら教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 搬入終了まで待つと決め終わったら声をかけてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll wait rather than hurry past them. Could you let me know when the deliveries are finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to wait until deliveries finish and ask to be called afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、受付から声をかけます。待っている間にお友達へ状況をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, reception will call you. Please tell your friend what's happening while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白い看板の所で搬入終了を待っていると送ります。呼ばれてから中庭へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機場所と搬入の事情を送り呼ばれてから中庭へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll send that I'm waiting at the white sign for the deliveries to finish. I'll go to the courtyard after I'm called.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll send your waiting location and the delivery situation and go to the courtyard after being called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付から見える椅子をご利用ください。お友達と無事に合流できますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use a chair visible from reception. I hope you meet your friend safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。問診票をお渡しします。今、お話しするのはつらくありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's your first visit. Here's the medical questionnaire. Is it difficult for you to speak right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声は少しかすれますが話せます。昨日の夜から喉が痛くて、今朝も続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 話せる状態と昨夜から続く喉の痛みを看護師に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My voice is a little hoarse, but I can speak. My throat has hurt since last night, and it's continuing this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the nurse you can speak and your throat pain has continued since last night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつからか、そのようにお書きください。何か薬は飲みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write when it started just as you described. Have you taken any medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜、市販の薬を一回飲みました。商品名を覚えていないので、何と書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市販薬を一回飲んだが名前が不明の場合の書き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took an over-the-counter medicine once last night. I don't remember the product name. What should I write?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to write that you took an over-the-counter medicine once but don't know its name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を推測せず、薬名不明と書いてください。包装や写真をお持ちなら確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't guess the name; write medicine name unknown. If you have the packaging or a photo, we can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を鞄に入れていました。これを見て、薬の名前を一緒に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の包装を差し出して名前の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had put the packet in my bag. Could you look at this and check the medicine's name with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the medicine packaging and ask to check its name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、包装を確認しますね。こちらの欄は薬のアレルギーについてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll check the packaging. This field is about medicine allergies.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬で困ったことがあったか覚えていません。「なし」ではなく「不明」にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬のアレルギーを覚えていないため不明と書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't remember whether I've had trouble with medicine. May I put unknown rather than none?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write unknown because you don't remember medicine allergies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 覚えていない場合は不明とし、診察でもそのようにお伝えください。保険の資格を確認できるものもお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you don't remember, put unknown and tell the doctor the same. We'll also take something that verifies your insurance eligibility.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資格を確認するものはこちらです。問診票には薬名と飲んだ時刻を書いて提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資格確認の資料を渡し薬名と服用時刻を記入して提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the eligibility document. I'll write the medicine's name and the time I took it on the questionnaire and submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over insurance eligibility evidence and say you'll write the medicine name and time taken and submit the questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。待つ間に息苦しさなどが出たら、すぐにお声がけください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take it. If you develop difficulty breathing or anything similar while waiting, call us immediately. I hope you feel better.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですか。提出先から指定された名称はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a certificate? Has the recipient specified an official name?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の契約用です。メールには住所が確認できる証明書としか書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸契約のメールに証明書の正式名称がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for a rental contract. The email only says a certificate that verifies the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the rental contract email doesn't give the certificate's official name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表現だけでは種類を決められませんね。証明したい方は、ご本人だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That wording alone doesn't identify the type. Is the certificate for you alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私と同居人の二人です。ただ、二人分を一枚でよいのかも指定されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人と同居人の二人分で一枚か別々か不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: For me and my housemate, two people. But they haven't specified whether one sheet for both is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it's for you and your housemate, and you don't know whether one sheet or separate sheets are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記載の範囲によって使える書類が変わるため、提出先に必要な名称と対象者を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The documents that can be used depend on the scope of the information shown. Please check the required name and people covered with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今ここで申請せず、管理会社にその二点を聞きます。個人番号を載せる必要があるかも尋ねたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請を保留し名称と対象者と個人番号の記載を提出先に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't apply here now; I'll ask the management company those two things. Should I also ask whether the individual number needs to appear?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off applying and say you'll ask the recipient about the name, people covered and individual-number inclusion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要のない情報まで載せないよう、求められる記載事項を具体的に確かめるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's best to check the specific information required so you don't include unnecessary details.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、名称、対象者、記載事項をメモします。回答が来たらこの窓口で相談し直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認事項を整理し回答後に窓口で相談し直せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll note the certificate name, people covered and required details. May I ask at this counter again when the reply comes?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the questions and ask whether you may consult the counter again after the reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。回答の文章をお持ちください。確認して、こちらで扱える証明書かご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Bring the written reply. We'll check and tell you whether it's a certificate we handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は用紙を持ち帰り、管理会社から回答を受けてから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙を持ち帰って管理会社の回答後に記入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take the form home and fill it in after receiving the management company's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the form home and fill it in after the management company's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入前のご確認で結構です。用紙をお渡ししますので、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Checking before filling it in is fine. I'll give you the form. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この棚は贈り物向けの布製品です。何かの記念でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This shelf has textile gifts. Is it for a special occasion?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越しを手伝ってくれた友人へのお礼です。鞄に入る薄い物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越しのお礼用に鞄に入る薄い贈り物を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's to thank a friend who helped me move. I'm looking for something thin that fits in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're seeking a thin gift that fits in a bag to thank someone for helping you move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大判の布と、小さなタオルがあります。ご予算はいくらぐらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are large cloths and small towels. Roughly what is your budget?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 包装まで入れて二千円以内です。友人は料理が好きなので、大判の布が気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装込み二千円の予算と料理好きの友人向けの大判布への関心を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Within two thousand yen including wrapping. My friend likes cooking, so the large cloth interests me.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State a two-thousand-yen budget including wrapping and interest in a large cloth for a friend who likes cooking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは千七百円で、紙の包装は百円です。厚い箱に入れると三百五十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is one thousand seven hundred yen, and paper wrapping is one hundred. A thick box would be three hundred and fifty.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱だと予算を超えるので紙にします。値札だけ外して、洗濯表示は残せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙包装を選び値札を外して洗濯表示を残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: A box would exceed my budget, so paper, please. Can you remove only the price tag and keep the washing label?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose paper wrapping and ask to remove the price tag but retain the washing label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、値札を外して包みます。色は紺と生成りのどちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll remove the price and wrap it. Would you like navy or unbleached natural color?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 汚れが目立ちにくそうな紺を一枚お願いします。渡すまで折ったままで大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紺を一枚選んで渡すまでの保管について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: One navy cloth, please; it looks less likely to show stains. Is it all right to keep it folded until I give it?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one navy cloth and ask about storing it until giving it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乾いた場所で保管してください。折りじわが気になる場合は、商品の表示に沿ってお手入れください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Store it in a dry place. If you're concerned about fold creases, follow the product label's care instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では紺一枚と紙包装で千八百円ですね。洗濯表示も相手に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紺一枚と紙包装の合計千八百円を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then one navy cloth and paper wrapping make one thousand eight hundred yen, correct? I'll give them the washing label too.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one navy cloth and paper wrapping total one thousand eight hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 千八百円で承ります。包んでお渡ししますので、少々お待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: One thousand eight hundred yen, yes. Please wait while we wrap it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのご相談はこちらで伺います。お持ちいただいたのは何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We can help with product concerns here. What have you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った乾燥わかめです。料理に使おうとしたら袋の端が裂けていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した乾燥わかめの袋の裂け目を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dried wakame I bought yesterday. When I tried to use it in cooking, the edge of the bag was torn.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a tear in the bag of dried wakame purchased yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入記録と、袋全体を確認させてください。中身は召し上がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the purchase record and the whole bag. Have you eaten any of the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べていません。こちらがレシートで、袋は気づいたときのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食べていないと説明しレシートと袋を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Here's the receipt, and I brought the bag just as it was when I noticed.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't eaten it and show the receipt and bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。持ち帰ってからは、どこに置いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked it. Where did you keep it after bringing it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台所の戸棚です。袋を引っ掛けた覚えはありませんが、破れた原因はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戸棚で保管し破損原因は不明だと正確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: In the kitchen cupboard. I don't remember catching the bag on anything, but I don't know what caused the tear.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accurately state storage in a cupboard and that the damage's cause is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因はここで断定せず、状態を記録します。同じ商品は売り切れなので、今回は返金で対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We won't determine the cause here; we'll record the condition. The same product is sold out, so this time we'll give a refund.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 代わりの商品を選ぶより返金を希望します。支払いに使ったカードも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金を選んで決済カードの提示が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd prefer a refund rather than choosing a replacement. Do you also need the card I paid with?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a refund and ask whether the payment card needs presenting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カード払いの記録ですね。取消処理のため、そのカードをご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The record shows card payment. Please present that card for the cancellation process.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このカードです。袋はそちらに渡し、返金の控えを受け取って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードと商品を渡し返金控えを受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the card. I'll give you the bag, receive the refund record and then leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll present the card and product and receive the refund record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品をお預かりし、手続きを進めます。控えをお渡ししますね。ご足労ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take the product and proceed. We'll give you the record. Thank you for coming in.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の届出用紙を確認します。こちらの新住所に部屋番号が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your address registration form. I don't see a room number in this new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 集合住宅の三〇二号室です。建物名だけ書いて、部屋番号を落としてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋番号三〇二の記入漏れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's apartment 302. I wrote only the building name and left out the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you omitted room number 302. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約書などで表記を確認できますか。隣の欄に書いた番号は何の番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you verify the wording using your contract or similar? What is the number in the next field?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書を持っています。隣の数字は管理会社の電話番号なので、住所に混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書を示し別欄の数字は管理会社の電話番号だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the contract. The number beside it is the management company's phone number, so please don't mix it into the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the contract and distinguish the number in another field as the management company's telephone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。住所欄だけ、契約書に合わせて補ってください。前の住所で受け取った書類も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Add only to the address field to match the contract. I'll also check the documents from your previous address.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これが前の自治体でもらった書類です。消しゴムで消せないので、訂正方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前住所の書類を提出し消せない文字の訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: These are the documents from the previous municipality. I can't erase the writing, so please tell me how to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Submit the previous-address documents and ask how to correct writing that can't be erased. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの用紙は二重線で直して、余白に正しい内容を書いてください。記入後に担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this form, cross it out with two lines and write the correct information in the margin. The staff will check after you've filled it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三〇二号室を加えました。一緒に引っ越した家族がいない場合、この同居家族欄はどう書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部屋番号を補って同居家族がいない場合の書き方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've added apartment 302. If no family moved with me, what do I write in this cohabiting-family field?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the room number and check how to write the field if you have no cohabiting family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 該当者がいないことがわかるよう「なし」と記入してください。他の書類と照合してから受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write none so it's clear that no one applies. We'll compare with the other documents before proceeding with acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族欄には「なし」と書きました。契約書の住所と訂正箇所をもう一度見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族欄の記入を終えて住所と訂正箇所の再確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written none in the family field. Please look again at the contract address and the corrections.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish the family field and ask to recheck the address and corrected parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では記載内容を照合します。契約書は確認後にお返ししますので、このまま窓口でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll compare the details. I'll return the contract after checking, so please stay at the counter and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの封筒をお持ちですね。まず、どちらの内容について伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two envelopes. Which one's contents shall we discuss first?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 支払いの封筒です。会社の源泉徴収票と一緒に持ってきましたが、同じ税なのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払い封筒と源泉徴収票の税の関係がわからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: The payment envelope. I brought it with my company's withholding statement, but I don't know whether they're the same tax.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about not understanding the tax relationship between the payment envelope and withholding statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の差出人を確認します。こちらは市の担当課からで、この窓口が扱う国税とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the sender. This one is from a municipal department, separate from the national tax handled here.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市からの封筒だったのですね。源泉徴収票を見れば、こちらで金額が正しいか判断できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市の通知の金額を国税の窓口で判断できるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's an envelope from the city. If you look at the withholding statement, can you judge here whether the amount is correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the national-tax counter can judge the municipal notice's amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通知の金額についてはこちらでは判断できません。市の担当課で、計算の根拠をお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't judge the amount on this notice. Please ask the municipal department about the calculation basis.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 納期限までに全額を用意できそうにありません。その相談も市の担当課にするのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 納期限までの全額納付が難しいと伝え納付相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't think I can have the full amount ready by the due date. Should I discuss that with the municipal department too?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say paying in full by the due date is difficult and ask whom to consult about payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知にある納付相談の連絡先に事情をお伝えください。分割が認められるかは、ここではお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Explain your circumstances to the payment-advice contact on the notice. We can't promise here whether installments will be approved.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に電話で相談します。封筒だけでなく中の通知と源泉徴収票も手元に置けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市へ電話する際に通知と源泉徴収票を準備するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call for advice first. Should I have not just the envelope but the notice inside and withholding statement at hand too?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether to prepare the notice and withholding statement when calling the city. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、通知の番号や記載内容を聞かれる場合があります。支払える時期と金額も整理しておくと説明しやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you may be asked for the notice number or details. Organizing when and how much you can pay will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知を捨てずに、払える日と金額をメモして市の連絡先へ電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払える日と金額を整理して市へ連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't throw away the notice. I'll note the dates and amounts I can pay and call the municipal contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to organize payable dates and amounts and contact the city. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この二つの封筒は分けてお返しします。担当先へのご相談が進むよう願っています。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll return the two envelopes separately. I hope your consultation with the right department goes well. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麺をゆでる前に伺います。並盛でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before boiling the noodles, may I check: is a regular portion all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 麺を半分にしてほしいです。それと、上に載る細い緑の物は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 麺半分を希望して緑の具材の名前を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like half the noodles. Also, what is the thin green thing on top?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for half noodles and the name of the green ingredient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ねぎです。苦手でしたら抜けますが、ねぎを抜けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Green onion. We can leave it out if you dislike it. Should we omit it?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ねぎは好きですが、香りの強い薬味が苦手です。辛い薬味も最初から入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ねぎは好むが香りの強い薬味が苦手だと説明し辛い薬味の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I like green onion, but dislike strongly aromatic condiments. Is a spicy condiment also added from the start?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you like green onion but dislike strongly aromatic condiments, and ask about spicy condiments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 辛い薬味は別の容器でお出ししています。丼には入れません。ねぎはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: We serve the spicy condiment in a separate container, not in the bowl. What would you like for the green onion?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ねぎも小皿に分けてください。半分の麺だと料金も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ねぎを別皿に頼み麺を減らした場合の料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Put the green onion on a small separate dish too, please. Does the price change with half the noodles?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for green onion separately and check the price when reducing noodles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 麺を減らしても料金は並盛と同じ八百円です。よろしければ、この内容で作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: The price stays the regular eight hundred yen even with fewer noodles. If that's fine, we'll make it this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八百円で大丈夫です。麺半分とねぎ別皿でお願いします。汁は普通の量で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八百円を了承して麺半分とねぎ別皿と普通量の汁を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Eight hundred yen is fine. Half noodles and separate green onion, please. The normal amount of broth is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept eight hundred yen and specify half noodles, separate onion and normal broth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。お飲み物は水と温かいお茶があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. For drinks, we have water and hot tea.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 温かいお茶をください。辛い薬味は使わないので、持ってこなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 温かいお茶を選び辛い薬味の容器は不要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hot tea, please. I won't use the spicy condiment, so you needn't bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose hot tea and say you don't need the spicy condiment container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬味の容器はお持ちせず、お茶をお出しします。出来上がるまでお待ちください。ご注文ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll serve tea without bringing the condiment container. Please wait until it's ready. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 閉館前の展示案内はこちらです。お連れ様をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here's exhibit information before closing. Are you waiting for someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父と別れて展示を見ていたのですが、待ち合わせ時刻を過ぎても来ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父との待ち合わせ時刻を過ぎても合流できないと受付に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father and I split up to see the exhibits, but he hasn't come even though our meeting time has passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell reception you haven't met your father even after the meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 携帯電話にはつながりますか。最後に会った場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you reach his mobile? Please also tell me where you last met.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話は電池が切れているようです。最後は模型の部屋にいて、私は出口で待つと伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話がつながらず最後は模型の部屋で出口を集合場所にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-04.translation: His phone seems to be out of battery. We were last in the model room, and I told him I'd wait at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain his phone can't be reached, you were last in the model room and set the exit as the meeting point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出口が二か所あるので、別の出口かもしれません。受付へのお呼び出しなら館内放送でできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are two exits, so he may be at the other one. We can make an announcement asking him to come to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父は放送の日本語を聞き取りにくいです。名前をゆっくり呼んで、受付に来るよう伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父のためゆっくりした名前の呼び出しと受付への誘導を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father has difficulty understanding announcements in Japanese. Could you call his name slowly and tell him to come to reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for his name to be called slowly and directions to reception for your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前を確認してから放送します。お客様も受付にいていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll confirm his name and announce it. Could you stay at reception too?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父の名前はこちらのメモに書きました。私も探し回らず、この受付の椅子で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前のメモを渡し探し回らず受付の椅子で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written his name on this note. I won't search around; I'll wait in this reception chair too.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the name note and say you'll wait in a reception chair rather than search around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。放送は館内のみなので、外に出ている場合は届きません。まず館内を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The announcement is only inside the building, so it won't reach him if he's outside. We'll check inside first.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外まで聞こえるわけではないのですね。館内の確認で見つからなければ、次の探し方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 放送範囲を理解し館内で見つからない場合の相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-10.translation: So it isn't audible outside. If he isn't found in the building, I'll ask about the next way to look.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the announcement's range and ask for advice if he isn't found inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お名前を預かって放送します。こちらの椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-011-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll take the name and announce it. Please wait in this chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 折り畳み傘は、その二種類を比べられる方が多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-01.translation: Many people compare those two folding umbrellas.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通勤鞄に入れる傘です。軽いほうと、この太いほうでは何が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通勤用の二種類の折り畳み傘の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my commuting bag. What's different between the lighter one and this thicker one?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between two folding umbrellas for commuting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 細いほうは軽量で、太いほうには吸水素材の収納袋が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-03.translation: The slim one is lightweight, and the thicker one includes a case made of absorbent material.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電車で濡れた傘を鞄に入れるので、吸水袋が気になります。袋だけ洗えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 濡れた傘を鞄に入れるため吸水袋の洗濯可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll put a wet umbrella in my bag on the train, so I'm interested in the absorbent case. Can the case alone be washed?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the absorbent case can be washed because you'll put a wet umbrella in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの袋は手洗いできます。傘を入れっぱなしにせず、帰宅後は傘も袋も乾かしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-05.translation: This case can be hand-washed. Don't leave the umbrella inside; dry both umbrella and case after getting home.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎日持つので、袋を含めた重さを手に取って比べてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋込みの重さを実物で比べる許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll carry it daily. May I hold them to compare the weight including the case?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask permission to compare their actual weights including cases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。細いほうは袋込み二百グラム、太いほうは三百グラムです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. The slim one is two hundred grams including the case; the thicker one is three hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 百グラムの差なら太いほうにします。予備の袋も買うと三千円以内になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 太い傘を選んで予備袋込みで三千円に収まるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-08.translation: For a hundred-gram difference, I'll choose the thicker one. If I also buy a spare case, will it stay within three thousand yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the thicker umbrella and ask whether it fits three thousand yen including a spare case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 傘が二千四百円、予備の袋が四百円なので、合計二千八百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-09.translation: The umbrella is two thousand four hundred yen and the spare case four hundred, for a total of two thousand eight hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二千八百円なら、傘と予備の袋を一つずつ買います。袋は交代で乾かして使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計二千八百円で傘と予備袋を一つずつ買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-10.translation: For two thousand eight hundred yen, I'll buy one umbrella and one spare case. I'll use the cases in rotation while drying them.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one umbrella and one spare case for a total of two thousand eight hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二点をご用意します。お手入れの表示もお付けしますね。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-012-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll prepare those two items. We'll include the care instructions too. Thank you.
